decisions.reason: This recruitment service looks relatively far from the firm's core transport and maritime support business, and the website shows persistence but no clear traction or scale-up evidence.
Superyacht crew recruitment is still a people-services offering but remains maritime-adjacent and was kept on the website across both years, which suggests a better strategic fit.
The maritime education programme fits the firm's sector well and already reached six partner institutions shortly after launch, indicating promising early adoption.
Emissions monitoring and compliance is strongly aligned with shipping operations and the firm demonstrated successful execution for all in-scope vessels before the regulatory deadline.
The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's existing ship-management software, making it a natural extension with likely customer stickiness.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool complements the broader compliance offering and its integration into core software makes it strategically valuable to retain.
